children: Baldwin Insurance Group agreed to be taken private in an all-cash transaction at $32.50 per share by Square Acquisition Parent, an affiliate of Sequence. The board and a special committee unanimously approved the deal, which will delist Baldwin from Nasdaq upon closing. To support the transaction, key holders signed Voting, Support and Rollover Agreements, while an amendment to the Tax Receivable Agreement provides for a termination payment at closing. Buyer financing includes equity committed by DFO and debt commitments from lenders, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
